    Cart Integration

    Choose how the chatbot handles "Add to Cart" actions. Configure the connection between your chatbot and your store's shopping cart.

    Integration Mode

    Product Link Redirect

    When customer clicks "Add to Cart", they are redirected to the product page on your store. The store handles cart and checkout natively. No code needed.

    Available on all plans
    Native Cart Sync ENTERPRISE

    Chatbot adds items to an in-chat cart and syncs with your store's cart via JavaScript. Customer can browse, add items, and checkout without leaving the chat.

    Requires Enterprise plan

    Product Link Settings

    Each product's Product URL field (set in the Products page) is used as the redirect link. Make sure all products have their URL filled in.

    How it works:
    1. Customer browses products in the chatbot
    2. Customer clicks "Add to Cart" on a product card
    3. A new tab opens with the product page on your store
    4. Customer adds to cart and checks out on your store

    Native Cart Sync Setup

    The chatbot manages a cart in the conversation. When items are added, a JavaScript message is sent to your website so you can sync it with your store's cart. Products with or without variants are fully supported.

    How it works:
    1. Customer adds a product in the chatbot (with variant selection if applicable)
    2. The chatbot sends a postMessage event to your website
    3. Your website listens for this event and adds the item to its native cart
    4. Customer can checkout from your store's cart (updated in real-time)

    Paste This Code on Your Website

    Add one of these snippets to your website to listen for add-to-cart events from the chatbot. The code handles products with and without variants.

    Add this to your website's HTML (before </body>) 
    <script>
window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
  if (!event.data || event.data.type !== 'chatgenius:add_to_cart') return;

  var productName = event.data.product_name;  // Product name (always sent)
  var quantity = event.data.quantity || 1;     // Quantity
  var price = event.data.price || 0;          // Unit price
  var variantOptions = event.data.variant_options; // null or {Size: "M", Color: "Blue"}

  // ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
  // ║  Step 1: Search YOUR store's products by name               ║
  // ║  Step 2: If variants exist, find the matching variant       ║
  // ║  Step 3: Add to YOUR cart                                   ║
  // ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

  // Search your store's API by product name
  fetch('/api/products/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(productName))
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(results) {
      if (!results.length) return console.warn('Product not found:', productName);
      var product = results[0];  // Best match

      var cartPayload = {
        product_id: product.id,  // YOUR store's real product ID
        quantity: quantity
      };

      // If chatbot selected variants, find the matching variant in YOUR system
      if (variantOptions && product.variants && product.variants.length) {
        var matched = product.variants.find(function(v) {
          return Object.keys(variantOptions).every(function(key) {
            return v.options && v.options[key] &&
              v.options[key].toLowerCase() === variantOptions[key].toLowerCase();
          });
        });
        if (matched) cartPayload.variant_id = matched.id;
      }

      // Add to YOUR store's cart
      return fetch('/api/cart/add', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(cartPayload)
      });
    })
    .then(function(r) {
      if (r && r.ok) console.log('Added to cart:', productName);
    })
    .catch(function(err) { console.error('Cart error:', err); });
});
</script>
    Add this to your Shopify theme (theme.liquid, before </body>) 
    <script>
window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
  if (!event.data || event.data.type !== 'chatgenius:add_to_cart') return;

  var productId = event.data.product_id;
  var quantity = event.data.quantity || 1;
  var variantOptions = event.data.variant_options; // e.g. {Size: "M", Color: "Blue"}

  // Fetch product to find the matching variant ID
  fetch('/products/' + productId + '.json')
    .then(function(r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
    .then(function(data) {
      if (!data || !data.product) return;
      var variants = data.product.variants;
      var variantId = variants[0].id; // Default to first variant

      // If specific variant options were selected, find the matching variant
      if (variantOptions && Object.keys(variantOptions).length > 0) {
        for (var i = 0; i < variants.length; i++) {
          var v = variants[i];
          var match = true;
          Object.keys(variantOptions).forEach(function(key) {
            if (v.option1 !== variantOptions[key] &&
                v.option2 !== variantOptions[key] &&
                v.option3 !== variantOptions[key]) {
              match = false;
            }
          });
          if (match) { variantId = v.id; break; }
        }
      }

      // Add to Shopify cart
      return fetch('/cart/add.js', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ items: [{ id: variantId, quantity: quantity }] })
      });
    })
    .then(function(r) {
      if (r && r.ok) {
        // Refresh cart drawer / mini cart
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cart:refresh'));
        console.log('Added to Shopify cart successfully');
      }
    })
    .catch(function(err) { console.error('Shopify cart error:', err); });
});
</script>
    Add this to your WordPress theme (functions.php + footer script) 
    <!-- Add this JavaScript to your WordPress footer -->
<script>
window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
  if (!event.data || event.data.type !== 'chatgenius:add_to_cart') return;

  var productId = event.data.product_id;
  var quantity = event.data.quantity || 1;
  var variantOptions = event.data.variant_options;

  // Build the add-to-cart URL
  var url = '/?add-to-cart=' + productId + '&quantity=' + quantity;

  // If variant options exist, find the variation ID via AJAX
  if (variantOptions && Object.keys(variantOptions).length > 0) {
    // WooCommerce variation lookup
    jQuery.ajax({
      url: wc_add_to_cart_params.wc_ajax_url.replace('%%endpoint%%', 'get_variation'),
      type: 'POST',
      data: {
        product_id: productId,
        attributes: variantOptions  // e.g. { attribute_pa_size: "medium", attribute_pa_color: "blue" }
      },
      success: function(variation) {
        if (variation && variation.variation_id) {
          jQuery.post('/?add-to-cart=' + productId + '&variation_id=' + variation.variation_id + '&quantity=' + quantity);
          jQuery(document.body).trigger('wc_fragment_refresh');
          jQuery(document.body).trigger('added_to_cart');
        }
      }
    });
  } else {
    // Simple product (no variants)
    jQuery.post(url, function() {
      jQuery(document.body).trigger('wc_fragment_refresh');
      jQuery(document.body).trigger('added_to_cart');
    });
  }
});
</script>
    Add this hook to your React / Next.js app 
    // useChatGeniusCart.js — Custom React hook
import { useEffect } from 'react';

export function useChatGeniusCart(addToCartFn) {
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleMessage(event) {
      if (!event.data || event.data.type !== 'chatgenius:add_to_cart') return;

      const {
        product_id,    // Your store's product ID / SKU
        product_name,  // Product name
        quantity = 1,  // Quantity
        price = 0,     // Unit price
        url = '',      // Product page URL
        variant_options = null  // null if no variants, or { Size: "M", Color: "Blue" }
      } = event.data;

      // Call your cart function
      addToCartFn({
        productId: product_id,
        name: product_name,
        quantity,
        price,
        url,
        variant: variant_options  // null for simple products
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
  }, [addToCartFn]);
}

// Usage in your component:
// import { useChatGeniusCart } from './useChatGeniusCart';
//
// function App() {
//   const { addItem } = useCart(); // your cart context
//
//   useChatGeniusCart((item) => {
//     addItem({
//       id: item.productId,
//       name: item.name,
//       price: item.price,
//       quantity: item.quantity,
//       variant: item.variant  // handle variant selection
//     });
//   });
//
//   return <div>...</div>;
// }
    Event Data Reference

    event.data.type 'chatgenius:add_to_cart' — always this value
    product_name Product name — use this to search your store's products. Always matches what the customer sees.
    quantity Number of items (default: 1)
    price Unit price
    url Product page URL (if set)
    variant_options null for simple products, or object like {"Size": "M", "Color": "Blue"}

    Chatbot cart is currently disabled

    Order Integration

    Connect your store's orders to ChatGenius so customers can ask "Where's my order?" and get real-time order status.

    Automatic Order Sync

    Pull all orders from your connected platform. Orders sync automatically and the chatbot can answer order status questions.

    Connected Platform: Not Connected
    How Platform Sync Works:
    1. Connect your Shopify or WooCommerce store in the Integrations page
    2. Click "Sync Orders Now" to pull all existing orders
    3. New orders are synced automatically going forward
    4. Customers can ask the chatbot about their order status, tracking, and delivery

    Order API & Code Snippets

    For custom stores or any platform. Send order events via API whenever an order is placed, updated, shipped, returned, or cancelled.

    When to use this: Use these API endpoints if you have a custom-built store, or use a platform we don't have a direct integration for. Copy the code in your preferred language, paste it into your backend, and replace the placeholder values. Leave any field blank if you don't have that data — only order_id is strictly required.

    API Endpoints

    POST /api/external/order Create or update an order (upsert)
    POST /api/external/order/status Update status & tracking only
    PUT /api/external/order/update Update any order fields
    DELETE /api/external/order/delete Delete an order
    Required Header: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

    Integration Flow

    Your Store
    →
    POST /api/external/order
    →
    Order saved
    →
    Chatbot answers order queries

    Create Order

    Send this when a customer completes a purchase. Include as many fields as you have — leave any field blank or remove it if not available.

    
                
    
            
    

            
            
    
                
    Platform-Specific Tips
    
                
    
                    
    Shopify: Use Shopify webhooks (Settings → Notifications → Webhooks) with topic orders/create and orders/updated, or paste the JS snippet in Checkout Additional Scripts using Liquid variables.
    
                    
    WooCommerce: Use WooCommerce webhooks (Settings → Advanced → Webhooks) with topic Order created / Order updated, or add PHP code in your functions.php.
    
                    
    Django / Flask / Express / Laravel: Call our API from your order processing logic after saving the order to your database.
    
                    
    Important: Only order_id is strictly required. All other fields are optional — include whatever data you have. If you don't have a field, just leave it out.

    Customer Integration
    
    
    Sync your customer data with ChatGenius so the chatbot can recognize returning customers, personalize conversations, and link orders to the right person.
    

    
    
        
    
            
    
                
            
    
            
    
                
    Automatic Customer Sync
    
                
    Customers are automatically created when they interact with the chatbot, submit a lead form, or place an order via webhook.
    
            
    
        
    

        
    
            
    How Customers Are Synced
    
            
    
                
    1.Chatbot conversations — When a customer shares their email or phone in the chat, a customer record is created.
    
                
    2.Lead capture forms — Leads captured via the chatbot widget form are automatically added as customers.
    
                
    3.Order webhooks — When you send an order via the Order Integration API, the customer is auto-created from the order's email/name/phone.
    
                
    4.Platform sync — Shopify/WooCommerce order sync also creates customer records automatically.
    
            
    
        
    

        
    
            Customer Matching: Customers are matched by email or phone number. Duplicate records with the same email or phone are automatically merged — they won't be counted as separate customers.
        
    

        
    
    

    
    
        
    
            
    
                
            
    
            
    
                
    Customer API (Advanced)
    
                
    For advanced integrations, use the Customer DB API to manage customers programmatically.
    
            
    
        
    
        
    Configure your Customer DB API credentials in the Integrations page. This enables external systems to fetch customer data and use it with the chatbot widget.
    

        
    
            
    API Endpoint
    
            GET /api/external/customer?email={email}
            
    Returns customer profile, order history, and preferences. Used by the chatbot embed to recognize logged-in customers.

    Setup Guide
    
                
    
                    
    1.Create a Meta Business Account at business.facebook.com
    
                    
    2.Go to Meta for Developers → Create an App → select Business type
    
                    
    3.Add the WhatsApp product to your app
    
                    
    4.In API Setup, copy your Phone Number ID and generate a Permanent Access Token
    
                    
    5.Paste them above and click Connect
    
                    
    6.Copy the Webhook URL and Verify Token into your Meta App's webhook settings
    
                    
    7.Subscribe to the messages webhook field — your chatbot will now reply on WhatsApp!

    Appointment Integration
    
            
    Sync appointments from your website or PMS with ChatGenius. When a patient books directly on your website, send the appointment to our API so the chatbot knows about it and avoids double-booking.
    

            
            
    
                How It Works
                
    

                    
    Overview
    
                    
    This integration allows your website or external PMS to push appointments directly into ChatGenius. Each company gets a permanent API key that never expires and never changes — use it in all your requests to authenticate which company the appointment belongs to.
    

                    
    Booking Flow
    
                    
    
                        
    1.Your website sends a POST request with patient info, doctor name, date, and time.
    
                        
    2.We validate the doctor exists in your account and the time is within the doctor's working hours for that day.
    
                        
    3.If the slot is free — the appointment is created and confirmed instantly. You get back a booking_id.
    
                        
    4.If the slot is taken — the patient is automatically added to the waitlist. An email is sent to the patient with two buttons:
    
                        
    
                            
    ●"Keep Me on Waitlist" — patient confirms they want to wait. If the main appointment is cancelled, they get moved in automatically.
    
                            
    ●"Remove Me from Waitlist" — patient is removed and won't be contacted again for this slot.
    
                        
    
                    
    

                    
    Time Handling
    
                    
    Send the start time only (e.g. 14:00 or 2:00 PM). The end time is calculated automatically based on the doctor's appointment length setting. Supports both 24-hour and 12-hour formats.
    

                    
    Working Hours Validation
    
                    
    Every request is validated against the doctor's schedule. If the doctor has a flexible schedule, we check the specific day's hours. If fixed, we use the general working hours. Requests on days off or outside working hours are rejected with a clear error message showing the doctor's actual hours.
    

                    
    Patient Deduplication
    
                    
    Patients are matched by email or phone. If the same patient books multiple times, they are recognized as one person — not counted as duplicates. The response includes is_returning: true/false so you know if this is a new or existing patient.
    

                    
    Your API Key
    
                    
    Your API key is permanent — it never expires and never changes, even if you log out. Each company has a unique key. Use it in the Authorization: Bearer header for all requests.
    

                
    
            
    

            
    
                
    API Endpoint
    
                POST /api/external/booking
                
    Headers:
    
                Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN
                Content-Type: application/json
            
    

            
    
                
    Create Appointment — Required JSON Body
    

    {
  "patient_name": "John Doe",           // Required — full name
  "patient_email": "john@example.com",   // Required — used for deduplication
  "patient_phone": "+1234567890",        // Required — used for deduplication
  "doctor_name": "Dr. Smith",            // Required — must match a doctor in your account
  "service": "Root Canal",               // Optional — if empty or omitted, will be set to "NA"
  "date": "2026-04-20",                  // Required — YYYY-MM-DD format
  "time": "14:00",                       // Required — HH:MM (24h format)
  "notes": "Patient prefers morning"     // Optional
}
    
                
    Duplicate patients (same email or phone) are automatically merged — they won't be counted as separate patients.
    
            
    

            
            
    
                
    Code Examples
    
                
    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                
    
                
    
                    
    
                    
                
    
                Copied to clipboard!
            
    

            
    
                Response Format & Error Codes
                
    
                    Success (201):
    
                    {"ok": true, "booking_id": 123, "patient_id": 45, "is_returning": false, "message": "Appointment synced successfully"}

    
                    Errors:
    
                    401 — Invalid or missing API key
    
                    400 — Missing required fields (patient_name, patient_email, patient_phone, doctor_name, date, time)
    
                    404 — Doctor not found in your account
    
                    409 — Time slot already booked for that doctor

    Shopify
    
                    Not Connected
                
    
                
    Connect your Shopify store so the chatbot can access your real product catalog, prices, inventory levels, and order data in real time.
    

                
    
                    How to Connect
                    
    
                        
    
                            
    1.In your Shopify admin, go to Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps
    
                            
    2.Click Create an app, name it "ChatGenius"
    
                            
    3.Under Configuration → Admin API access scopes, enable: read_products, read_inventory, read_orders
    
                            
    4.Click Install app, then copy the Admin API access token (starts with shpat_)
    
                            
    5.Paste it below along with your store URL
    
                        
    
                    
    
                
    

                
    
                    
    
                        
                        
                        Your .myshopify.com domain (not your custom domain)

    Woo
    
                    
    WooCommerce
    
                    Not Connected
                
    
                
    Connect your WooCommerce store to sync products, inventory, and order data with the chatbot.
    

                
    
                    How to Connect
                    
    
                        
    
                            
    1.In your WordPress admin, go to WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API
    
                            
    2.Click Add key, set description to "ChatGenius", permissions to Read
    
                            
    3.Click Generate API key
    
                            
    4.Copy the Consumer Key (ck_...) and Consumer Secret (cs_...)
    
                            
    5.Paste them below along with your store URL
    
                        
    
                        
    
                            Your site must use HTTPS. WooCommerce REST API requires SSL for authentication.

    Product Page Links
    
                
    
                
    Set the link to each product's page on your website. When a customer adds a product via the chatbot, they'll be redirected to this page to complete the purchase with the right size, color, and options.
    

                
    
                    
                    Products with a link set will open the product page when a customer says "add to cart". Products without a link will use the chatbot's built-in cart instead.

    Import Products from Website
    
                
    
                
    Paste your store URL and we'll automatically find and import all your products — names, prices, images, descriptions, and more.
    

                
    
                    
    
                        
                        
                        
                            Paste the link to your store's product listing page, collection page, or homepage. We'll scan the site for all products.

    Tips for best results
    
                    
    
                        
    • Use your shop/collections page — not individual product pages
    
                        
    • Works best with stores that have product structured data (most modern platforms do)
    
                        
    • Supports WooCommerce, Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, Squarespace, Wix, and custom stores
    
                        
    • Maximum 50 products per import — run multiple times for larger catalogs
    
                    
    
                
    
            
    

            
            
    
                
    
                    
    
                        
                    
    
                    
    Order Webhooks
    
                
    
                
    Send order events to ChatGenius so the chatbot can answer "Where's my order?" and provide real-time order status to your customers.
    

                
    
                    How It Works
                    
    
                        
    
                            
    1.When an order is placed, shipped, or delivered, send a webhook to our API with the order details.
    
                            
    2.The chatbot stores the order and links it to the customer by email or phone.
    
                            
    3.When a customer asks about their order, the chatbot responds with the latest status, tracking number, and estimated delivery.
    
                        
    
                        
    
                            Shopify / WooCommerce users: If you connected Shopify or WooCommerce above, order tracking is automatic — you don't need to use this webhook.
                        
    
                    
    
                
    

                
    
                    
    API Endpoint
    
                    POST /api/external/order
                    
    Headers:
    
                    Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN
                    Content-Type: application/json
                
    

                
    
                    
    Send Order Event — JSON Body
    

    {
  "order_id": "ORD-10042",                    // Required
  "customer_email": "jane@example.com",        // Required — used to match customer
  "customer_name": "Jane Doe",                 // Optional
  "customer_phone": "+1234567890",             // Optional — fallback match
  "status": "shipped",                         // Required: pending|confirmed|shipped|delivered|cancelled|refunded
  "total": 124.99,                             // Optional
  "currency": "USD",                           // Optional, default: USD
  "tracking_number": "1Z999AA10123456784",     // Optional
  "tracking_url": "https://ups.com/track/...", // Optional
  "carrier": "UPS",                            // Optional
  "estimated_delivery": "2026-05-12",          // Optional — YYYY-MM-DD
  "items": [                                   // Optional
    { "name": "Classic White Sneakers", "qty": 1, "price": 89.99 },
    { "name": "Canvas Tote Bag", "qty": 1, "price": 34.50 }
  ]
}
    
                    
    Send this webhook each time the order status changes. The chatbot always shows the latest status received.
    
                
    

                
                
    
                    
    1. When an Order Is Placed
    
                    
    Add this to your checkout/order confirmation flow. The API will create the order AND the customer record automatically.
    

                    
    
                        
                        
                        
                        
                    
    

    # Place this in your order confirmation function
import requests

def send_order_to_chatgenius(order):
    requests.post(
        'https://chatgeniusx.com/api/external/order',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'},
        json={
            'order_id':         order['id'],
            'customer_email':   order['email'],
            'customer_name':    order['name'],
            'customer_phone':   order.get('phone', ''),
            'status':           'confirmed',
            'total':            order['total'],
            'currency':         'USD',
            'items': [{'name': i['name'], 'qty': i['qty'], 'price': i['price']} for i in order['items']]
        },
        timeout=10
    )
    

    // Place this in your order confirmation handler
async function sendOrderToChatGenius(order) {
  await fetch('https://chatgeniusx.com/api/external/order', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      order_id:        order.id,
      customer_email:  order.email,
      customer_name:   order.name,
      customer_phone:  order.phone || '',
      status:          'confirmed',
      total:           order.total,
      currency:        'USD',
      items:           order.items.map(i => ({ name: i.name, qty: i.qty, price: i.price }))
    })
  });
}
    

    // Place this in your order confirmation function
function sendOrderToChatGenius($order) {
    $ch = curl_init('https://chatgeniusx.com/api/external/order');
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_POST           => true,
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => [
            'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY',
            'Content-Type: application/json'
        ],
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => json_encode([
            'order_id'        => $order['id'],
            'customer_email'  => $order['email'],
            'customer_name'   => $order['name'],
            'status'          => 'confirmed',
            'total'           => $order['total'],
            'items'           => $order['items']
        ])
    ]);
    curl_exec($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
}
    

    curl -X POST https://chatgeniusx.com/api/external/order \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "order_id": "ORD-10042",
    "customer_email": "jane@example.com",
    "customer_name": "Jane Doe",
    "status": "confirmed",
    "total": 124.99,
    "items": [{"name": "Sneakers", "qty": 1, "price": 89.99}]
  }'
    
                
    

                
                
    
                    
    2. When Order Status Changes
    
                    
    Use this lighter endpoint when an order is shipped, delivered, or cancelled. You only need the order_id and new status.
    
                    POST /api/external/order/status

                    
    
                        
                        
                        
                        
                    
    

    # Call this when order ships, delivers, or is cancelled
def update_order_status(order_id, status, tracking_number='', carrier=''):
    requests.post(
        'https://chatgeniusx.com/api/external/order/status',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'},
        json={
            'order_id':         order_id,
            'status':           status,       # shipped | delivered | cancelled
            'tracking_number':  tracking_number,
            'carrier':          carrier,      # UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL, etc.
            'estimated_delivery': '2026-05-15'
        },
        timeout=10
    )

# Examples:
update_order_status('ORD-10042', 'shipped', '1Z999AA10123456784', 'UPS')
update_order_status('ORD-10042', 'delivered')
    

    // Call this when order status changes
async function updateOrderStatus(orderId, status, trackingNumber, carrier) {
  await fetch('https://chatgeniusx.com/api/external/order/status', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      order_id:         orderId,
      status,                              // shipped | delivered | cancelled
      tracking_number:  trackingNumber || '',
      carrier:          carrier || ''
    })
  });
}

// Examples:
await updateOrderStatus('ORD-10042', 'shipped', '1Z999AA10123456784', 'UPS');
await updateOrderStatus('ORD-10042', 'delivered');
    

    // Call this when order status changes
function updateOrderStatus($orderId, $status, $trackingNumber = '', $carrier = '') {
    $ch = curl_init('https://chatgeniusx.com/api/external/order/status');
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_POST           => true,
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => [
            'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY',
            'Content-Type: application/json'
        ],
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => json_encode([
            'order_id'         => $orderId,
            'status'           => $status,
            'tracking_number'  => $trackingNumber,
            'carrier'          => $carrier
        ])
    ]);
    curl_exec($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
}
    

    curl -X POST https://chatgeniusx.com/api/external/order/status \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "order_id": "ORD-10042",
    "status": "shipped",
    "tracking_number": "1Z999AA10123456784",
    "carrier": "UPS",
    "estimated_delivery": "2026-05-15"
  }'
    
                
    

                
                
    
                    
    Integration Flow
    
                    
    
                        
    Your Store
    
                        →
                        
    POST /api/external/order
    
                        →
                        
    Order + Customer saved
    
                        →
                        
    Chatbot answers "Where's my order?"
    
                    
    
                    
    
                        
    Status changes
    
                        →
                        
    POST /api/external/order/status
    
                        →
                        
    Tracking info updated
    
                    
    
                
    

                
    
                    Response Format & Error Codes
                    
    
                        Create/Update Order (200):
    
                        {"ok": true, "order_id": "ORD-10042", "is_new": true, "message": "Order ORD-10042 created"}

    
                        Status Update (200):
    
                        {"ok": true, "order_id": "ORD-10042", "status": "shipped", "message": "Order ORD-10042 status updated to shipped"}

    
                        Errors:
    
                        401 — Invalid or missing API key
    
                        400 — Missing required fields (order_id)
    
                        404 — Order not found (status update only)
    
                        422 — Invalid status value (must be: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded)
                    
    
                
    

                
    
                    What Your Customers Can Ask the Chatbot
                    
    
                        Once orders are synced, your customers can ask things like:
    
                        
    
                            "Where's my order #ORD-10042?"
                            "What's the status of my order?"
                            "Track my package"
                            "When will my order arrive?"
                            "I want to return my order"
                        
    
                        
    
                            Tip: If the customer is logged in (email known), the chatbot automatically finds their orders — no order number needed!
